## Sales Development Representative

Sales & Business Development

New York, NY, USA

Posted6+ months ago

[**About CyberCube:**](https://www.cybcube.com/careers)

- The market leader in **digital analytics** 📊 with the mission of delivering the **world’s leading cyber risk analytics** 🌐 on one of the most critical risks of today and [**the future.**](https://www.cybcube.com/news/predicted-2034-us-cyber-insurance-growth)

- Exceptionally well-funded startup 💰 that has raised over **$100MM** from top-tier investors.

- Explosive team growth 🚀 (from 15 employees in SF to **100+ globally** 🌍).

- Used by 75% of the top 40 US and European cyber insurance carriers & [**surpassing 100 clients in 2023**](https://www.cybcube.com/news/cybercube-closes-strong-year-as-it-surpasses-100-clients) with a **>99% retention rate**.

- CyberCube and its products consistently earn industry recognition 🏆, including awards like **Forbes** **America's Best Startup Employers 2025** and **Cyber Risk Solution of the Year in 2025.**

- Senior [**leadership**](https://www.cybcube.com/team/leadership-team/#about) is committed to **attracting, developing,** and **exciting** exceptional people from **diverse backgrounds** and enabling them to **work collaboratively** across disciplines to do the **best work of their careers.**

- At CyberCube, we **drive ownership for excellence** ✅, empowering our team to take initiative, deliver results, and continually raise the bar.

- Named on [**Forbes’ America’s Best Startup Employers**](https://www.forbes.com/lists/americas-best-startup-employers/) list three years in a row (2021, 2022, 2023)! 🎖️

- Learn what it’s like to be part of CyberCube’s mission: [**Watch this leadership team interview!**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C6VUwyTcMZo&t=35s) 🎥


### What You’ll Be Doing:

- Drive growth by qualifying leads and moving them through the sales pipeline, securing high-value meetings for our sales team

- Proactively reach out to potential clients through multi-channel outreach—cold calls, emails, social, and industry events

- Get to know prospects and uncover their challenges to help them understand where CyberCube can bring real value

- Share product information and insights once needs are identified—you're a trusted first point of contact

- Use tools like Hubspot, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to research, build lists, and refine your outreach

- Partner with Marketing to shape demand generation campaigns and identify key targets

- Brainstorm new strategies with Sales leadership to open doors and meet quarterly/annual goals

- Keep our Hubspot CRM up to date with contacts and activity—your insights help drive our overall sales motion


### What We’re Looking For:

- 1+ years of experience in sales or lead generation, ideally in tech or software

- Strong critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills—non-traditional backgrounds are welcome!

- Experience with CRM tools (Hubspot is a plus)

- Clear communicator—both written and verbal—with a natural ability to connect

- Energetic on the phone and resilient in the face of challenges

- Self-motivated and proactive—you like figuring things out and running with them

- Coachable and eager to keep learning and growing


### Why You’ll Love It Here:

- You’ll help change how one of the oldest industries operates—by bringing advanced analytics into the spotlight

- Competitive salary and meaningful early-stage equity

- Unlimited PTO and flexible working hours

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance

- Monthly catered lunches and happy hours (when in office)

- Learning & development support and mentorship programs

- Remote-friendly, hybrid options, and international secondment opportunities

- Dependent care assistance

- A collaborative, supportive, and values-driven culture


#LI-Remote #LI-Hybrid
